name: ai-company-os
description: AI Startup Company OS — a virtual software company staffed by Kiro-powered AI employees, owned by one human.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
